metadata.description: Pork is an inseparable part of the Bodo tribe’s food culture, cooked in countless delicious and traditional ways. In this episode of Tribal Kitchen, we visited a Bodo family to experience one such special pork dish — but there was one little twist! The name of the dish, spoken in the Bodo language, turned out to be quite a tongue twister for our anchor. His repeated attempts to pronounce it correctly left everyone bursting into laughter. Amidst the fun and warmth, the family shared the story and flavour of their traditional recipe, reminding us that food is not just about taste — it’s about joy, connection, and culture.
